title: pair/1: the [M+H]+ and [M-H]- features of two polarity methods paired by neutral mass and RT
description: The answer of `mzlab-cli table pair --json` and of the `features.pair` Flow step (same bytes in the site and the app): every positive row is paired with every negative row whose neutral mass (from the adduct lists, user-editable) agrees within `mass_tol` and whose RT agrees within `rt_tol`; `csv` is the same table as text. Rows left without a partner are in `unmatched`; every automatic choice (the rule, the adduct lists, the sign of the mass error, how `mutual` is decided) is in `choices`. Nothing is refused for a finding; identification of the compounds is out of scope. Code: crates/mzlab-core/src/polarity_pair/.

rt_tol.description: RT agreement of the two rows, min.

pos_adducts.description: The positive adducts used, as written in the request (catalog names or LABEL:SHIFT, comma separated).

neg_adducts.description: The negative adducts used, same form.

pairs.description: Every pair within both tolerances, by neutral mass.

rule.description: The adducts that made the pair, e.g. `[M+H]+ / [M-H]-`.

neutral_mass.description: Mean of the two neutral masses, Da.

err_da.description: Neutral mass of the negative row minus that of the positive row, Da.

drt.description: RT of the negative row minus RT of the positive row, min.

dist.description: Distance used to choose the nearest partner: the mass and RT errors scaled by their tolerances.

mutual.description: True when each row is the nearest partner of the other.

pos_partners.description: Pairs the positive row is in.

neg_partners.description: Pairs the negative row is in.

csv.description: Header pos_id,neg_id,rule,neutral_mass,err_da,err_ppm,rt_pos,rt_neg,drt,mutual; the unmatched rows last with rule `unmatched`.
